1. Purpose

2. Registration

legal.privacy_content:
1. Information Collected

Through ATProto OAuth, the service obtains your DID (identifier) and handle and stores them in the service's database. The service also stores OAuth session data (such as access tokens) on its server so that it can write and delete records in your own PDS on your behalf.

To prevent excessive login attempts, the service temporarily (for about one minute) uses the connecting IP address in server memory.

2. Information Recorded When Joining, Requesting, or Creating a Ring

When you join or request to join a ring, or create a ring and add your own site to it, your site's URL, site name, and RSS feed URL (optional) are written as records to your own PDS (your ATProto repository). When you create a ring, its name, description, and acceptance policy are recorded; when an admin approves, rejects, or blocks a member, that decision is recorded; each in the PDS of the user who performed the action. If you upload a banner image, the image is also stored in your PDS.

By the design of ATProto, PDS records are public and can be viewed by anyone, including outside this service. This information is also cached in the service's database for display and search.

If you register an RSS feed URL, the service's server periodically fetches the feed and stores item titles, URLs, and publication dates in its database to show them in the "Antenna". When a ring admin checks whether the widget is installed, the service's server accesses the member's site to check for the widget.

3. Use of Information

Collected information is used for user identification, providing the webring features, and showing profile links.

4. Data Sent to External Services

  • Handle suggestions: When you type two or more characters into the handle field on the login page, the partial text is sent directly from your browser to Bluesky's public API (app.bsky.actor.searchActorsTypeahead on public.api.bsky.app) to show suggestions (handle, display name, avatar). This text is not sent to or stored by the service's server.
  • Fetching public ATProto data: To resolve handles and DIDs and to fetch profiles (public information such as display name, avatar, and bio), the service's server sends requests containing DIDs or handles to Bluesky's public API (public.api.bsky.app), the PLC directory (plc.directory), and each user's PDS.
  • Site suggestions: On the dashboard, the service's server fetches URLs found in your Bluesky profile bio and checks their site names and RSS feeds to suggest sites to register.
  • Approval notifications: When your request to join an approval-based ring is approved, the service's official account (@atcircle.bsky.social) publishes a Bluesky post that mentions you and includes your handle and the ring name. This post is public and can be seen by anyone.
  • Fonts: Every page loads fonts from Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com), which sends a request from the visitor's browser to Google's servers.
  • External libraries on the companion page: The ring companion page (/rings/companion) loads stylesheets from cdn.jsdelivr.net and cdnjs.cloudflare.com.

5. Analytics

This service uses Simple Analytics, a privacy-friendly analytics tool. It does not use cookies and does not collect personally identifiable information.

In addition, the footer of every page displays a Simple Analytics badge image loaded from simpleanalyticsbadges.com. Loading it sends a request from the visitor's browser to that company's servers (configured not to send a referrer).

6. Cookies and Browser Storage

To keep you logged in, the service uses a signed session cookie (HttpOnly, valid for 7 days). It also uses a cookie that temporarily remembers which page to return to after login.

The ring companion feature stores the current ring and your browsing history within the ring in your browser's localStorage. This data stays in your browser and is not sent to the service's server.

7. Third-Party Sharing

Information is not shared with third parties except as required by law. However, as described in Section 2, records written to your PDS are public by the design of ATProto, and data is sent to the external services described in Sections 4 and 5.

8. Data Deletion

When you delete your account from the dashboard, your user information, site information, memberships, join requests, rings you own, and Antenna items stored in the service's database are deleted.

Records written to your own PDS are not deleted when you delete your account. When you leave a ring, the corresponding membership (or join request) record is deleted from your PDS. You can also delete PDS records yourself on your PDS.

Last revised: November 2026
